title: Postgres Query Health
description: pg_stat_statements and live wait-event view for notifier claim/discovery/retention queries. Reset pg_stat_statements before a controlled benchmark window if you want clean deltas.

panels.title: Total Query Calls
panels.description: Cumulative statement call count since the last pg_stat_statements reset.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(calls), 0)::bigint AS total_calls FROM pg_stat_statements;

panels.title: Total Exec Time
panels.description: Cumulative SQL execution time since the last pg_stat_statements reset.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_exec_time), 0)::double precision / 1000.0 AS total_exec_seconds FROM pg_stat_statements;

panels.title: Slowest Mean Query
panels.description: The current maximum mean execution time across all tracked statements.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(mean_exec_time), 0)::double precision AS max_mean_ms FROM pg_stat_statements;

panels.title: Calls Per Second Since Reset
panels.description: Average query call rate since the last pg_stat_statements reset. Use this as a benchmark-window delta signal.

targets.rawSql: WITH reset AS (SELECT stats_reset FROM pg_stat_statements_info), totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(calls), 0)::double precision AS calls_total FROM pg_stat_statements) SELECT totals.calls_total / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - reset.stats_reset)), 1) AS calls_per_sec_since_reset FROM totals CROSS JOIN reset;

panels.title: Exec Seconds Per Second Since Reset
panels.description: Average SQL execution time per second since the last pg_stat_statements reset. Higher values indicate more DB time burned by the workload.

targets.rawSql: WITH reset AS (SELECT stats_reset FROM pg_stat_statements_info), totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_exec_time), 0)::double precision AS total_exec_ms FROM pg_stat_statements) SELECT totals.total_exec_ms / 1000.0 / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - reset.stats_reset)), 1) AS exec_seconds_per_sec_since_reset FROM totals CROSS JOIN reset;

panels.title: Mean Exec Time Since Reset
panels.description: Average statement mean latency since the last pg_stat_statements reset.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_exec_time), 0)::double precision / GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(calls), 0), 1) AS mean_exec_ms_since_reset FROM pg_stat_statements;

panels.title: Top SQL By Total Exec Time
panels.description: Highest cumulative cost statements since the last reset. Look here first when claim latency regresses.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEFT(regexp_replace(query, '\\s+', ' ', 'g'), 140) AS query_snippet, calls, round(total_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS total_exec_ms, round(mean_exec_time::numeric, 3) AS mean_exec_ms, round((rows::numeric / NULLIF(calls, 0)), 3) AS rows_per_call, shared_blks_hit, shared_blks_read, temp_blks_read, temp_blks_written FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Claim / Discovery / Retention SQL
panels.description: Narrow view for the hot queue SQL families when tuning wakeups, discovery cadence, or retention.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEFT(regexp_replace(query, '\\s+', ' ', 'g'), 160) AS query_snippet, calls, round(total_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS total_exec_ms, round(mean_exec_time::numeric, 3) AS mean_exec_ms, round((rows::numeric / NULLIF(calls, 0)), 3) AS rows_per_call, shared_blks_hit, shared_blks_read FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE lower(query) LIKE '%claim%' OR lower(query) LIKE '%discover%' OR lower(query) LIKE '%retention%' OR lower(query) LIKE '%archive%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Queue-Path SQL
panels.description: Statements touching deliveries, delivery_claims, or delivery_history. Use this for targeted regressions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEFT(regexp_replace(query, '\\s+', ' ', 'g'), 160) AS query_snippet, calls, round(total_exec_time::numeric, 2) AS total_exec_ms, round(mean_exec_time::numeric, 3) AS mean_exec_ms, round((rows::numeric / NULLIF(calls, 0)), 3) AS rows_per_call, shared_blks_hit, shared_blks_read FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE lower(query) LIKE '%deliveries%' OR lower(query) LIKE '%delivery_claims%' OR lower(query) LIKE '%delivery_history%' ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Current Wait Events
panels.description: Live wait-event mix for the notifier database. Useful for spotting lock, WAL, or IO pressure while the queue is hot.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(wait_event_type, 'running') AS wait_event_type, COALESCE(wait_event, 'running') AS wait_event, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY sessions DESC, wait_event_type, wait_event;
